$comment: The cards have no link, so the track is a tab stop (tabindex 0). Slide labels read "Slide 1 of 3": labels.slide followed by "{n} of {N}". The inline card's title is a plain heading (no href, no arrow).
summary: Three inline generic cards with images under a heading: a carousel region named from the heading, slides wrapping the cards. The previous and next controls are mounted by script and are not in the server HTML.
